remarks: Nestled within the quiet Portal Rock Condominium Association, this 2023 renovated 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath, townhome is the perfect blend of updated amenities with a prime Cos Cob location. Featuring a bright and spacious interior, the main level boasts an inviting living/dining area that opens to a balcony, stylish kitchen and updated powder room. Upstairs, 3 nice-sized bedrooms and a modern bath provide comfortable living spaces. The fully finished lower level, complete with laundry room and sliding doors to a private stone patio, is the perfect space for a playroom, family room, fitness room or office. Dedicated parking is conveniently located in front of the unit, and the complex is just minutes from the train, town, school, parks & library. Available for immediate occupancy with a flexible lease term.
